body: SCOUT SECOND RUNNABLE HOLD on cost-support candidate content 19510e9. Disposable ordinary clone on exact main e4bbf5b plus the candidate commit; no reserved path touched. Focused 1/1 proves the library produces a state its wire rejects: CostWeights.of lawfully accepts semantic/propositional/entity/granularity/contradiction/chart/structural = 0 and sensory = 1; for a sensory-absent unit DefaultLocalCostModel.cost produces supportWeight = 0.0, then AlignWire.costBreakdown rejects that exact field because its guard requires (0,1]. A measured-weight share can honestly be zero, especially because the design says consumers may refuse weak support. Likely repair: admit finite [0,1] and pin a zero-support round trip, unless CostWeights is deliberately narrowed or cost returns a typed refusal. Also the focused compile emits an unused import warning at CostSuite.scala:5 for RecallUnit; remove under warnings-clean policy. hsmm/v1 schema HOLD remains independent.
